properties.field_evidence: Planning Data official authoritative listed-building-outline entity 42118135, Great Yarmouth Borough Council, dated 2023-07-17, identifies one non-zero-area closed MULTIPOLYGON for EMPIRE CINEMA, reference 1271550. Historic England official NHLE 1271550 confirms Empire Cinema, Marine Parade, Grade II, first listed 15-Feb-1990, purpose-built as cinema in 1911 by Arthur S Hewitt. The 2010-amended statutory entry confirms it is no longer used as a cinema and mentions later nightclub use, so the type Cinema is historical and is not asserted as current operation. The official listed-building polygon is not claimed to represent exact curtilage structures or cadastral parcels.
